jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ghost is an applied AI company building personal agents

We're well-funded and assembling an aggressively young, talented team to work on the hardest unsolved problems in agentic systems and product.

Existing team members have left the world's leading quant shops and universities and turned down millions of dollars of cash/equity to build real products for billions of humans at Ghost.

Apply for the founding eng role if you:

  • Use agents to write >90% of your code

  • Have done exceptional things in the past

  • Have the endurance to prompt 12hrs+ in a day
